SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) rl, sum(f.quantity) qty, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.sale_date) mind, max(f.sale_date) maxd
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 22 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stock AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(w.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week w
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = w.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = w.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE w.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
), sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, st.category, st.closing_units, ROUND(so.units_4w / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold,
       ROUND(st.closing_units / (so.units_4w / 4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st JOIN sold so ON so.category = st.category ORDER BY st.category

WITH w AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, w.week_ending_date, w.closing_units, w.receipts_units, w.adjustment_units
  FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
  WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-13' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
sold AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, d.fiscal_week_end_date AS week_ending_date, SUM(f.quantity) q
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1,2,3),
j AS (
  SELECT cur.store_id, cur.sku, cur.closing_units, pr.closing_units AS prev_close, cur.receipts_units, cur.adjustment_units, COALESCE(so.q,0) q
  FROM w cur JOIN w pr ON pr.store_id=cur.store_id AND pr.sku=cur.sku AND pr.week_ending_date=cur.week_ending_date - 7
  LEFT JOIN sold so ON so.store_id=cur.store_id AND so.sku=cur.sku AND so.week_ending_date=cur.week_ending_date
  WHERE cur.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units = prev_close + receipts_units - q + adjustment_units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) flow_ok, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units = prev_close THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unchanged, sum(adjustment_units) adj, sum(CASE WHEN adjustment_units<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) adj_rows
FROM j
